verdict.rationale: Daily hosts voice and video AI agents through Pipecat, so it is fair to ask whether those agents can connect to MCP servers and use their tools. The evidence never mentions MCP client support, MCP server integration, or tool plugging for Daily or Pipecat. The llms.txt and OpenAPI probes show machine-readable docs, but that is an adjacent feature and does not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
